nodes.label: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents
nodes.author: Jundong Xu, Qingchuan Li, et al.
nodes.rationale: Introduces EvoArena benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in dynamic, evolving environments and proposes EvoMem, a patch-based memory paradigm for tracking environment evolution.

nodes.label: EvoArena: Multi-Domain Benchmark for Evolving Environments
nodes.rationale: Benchmark suite modeling environment changes as sequences of progressive updates across terminal, software, and social domains; tests persistent environment evolution capability.

nodes.label: Terminal-Bench-Evo: Executable Workflow Evolution
nodes.rationale: Evaluates agents on evolving terminal workflows where dependencies, interfaces, paths, and validation scripts change across versions while preserving underlying objective.

nodes.label: SWE-Chain-Evo: Software Evolution Chains
nodes.rationale: Evaluates agents on chronological chains of software milestones where earlier API changes, dependencies, and implementation decisions remain active for later requirements.

nodes.label: PersonaMem-Evo: Preference Evolution in Long-Horizon Conversations
nodes.rationale: Evaluates agents on inferring and tracking evolving user preferences across long mixed-topic conversations; tests temporal trajectory and multi-pattern synthesis reasoning.

nodes.label: EvoMem: Patch-Based Memory Evolution Paradigm
nodes.rationale: Lightweight memory paradigm recording memory evolution as structured update histories; enables agents to reason about environmental evolution through changes in memory with append-only patch history.

nodes.label: Terminus2: Terminal-Native Agent System
nodes.rationale: Terminal-native agent without persistent memory module; instantiated with EvoMem to record strategy changes caused by evolving terminal environments.

nodes.label: OpenHands: Software Engineering Agent
nodes.rationale: Software engineering agent maintaining distilled context from trajectories; instantiated with EvoMem to record superseded implementation strategies and revised logic.

nodes.label: A-Mem: Agentic Memory System
nodes.rationale: Semantically organized memory system with notes and links; instantiated with EvoMem at note and relation update level for evolving user preferences.

nodes.label: Memento-Skill: Reusable Skill Memory Agent
nodes.rationale: Maintains global TIP.md file as reusable skill memory; instantiated with EvoMem to preserve task-specific corrections that may be diluted in consolidated skill file.

nodes.label: GPT-5.5: OpenAI Language Model
nodes.rationale: Backbone LLM model evaluated across multiple benchmarks; achieves highest terminal accuracy (62.8%) but with substantial token consumption (505.0M).

nodes.label: Gemini-3.1-Pro: Google Language Model
nodes.rationale: Backbone LLM model achieving strong accuracy on multiple benchmarks with moderate token efficiency.

nodes.label: State Collapse: Memory Brittleness in Evolving Environments
nodes.rationale: Recurring failure mode where memory-based agents maintain only latest state, losing context of prior valid behaviors when environment versions require different actions.

nodes.label: Version-Aware State Tracking: Core Design Principle
nodes.rationale: Design principle requiring agents to retain latest memory, recover relevant prior states, and reason over why each update occurred for robust deployment.

nodes.label: Patch Recording: Memory Update Preservation
nodes.rationale: Mechanism storing meaningful non-additive memory updates including what changed, why it changed, and which evidence triggered the update.

nodes.label: Patch-Augmented Retrieval: Version-Aware Evidence Access
nodes.rationale: Retrieval mechanism accessing relevant historical patches together with latest memory when query depends on overwritten states, temporal changes, or version-specific behavior.

nodes.label: Chain-Level Accuracy: Consecutive Task Completion
nodes.rationale: Evaluation metric measuring success over temporally linked task sequences; requires completing consecutive related evolutionary subtasks without failure.

nodes.label: Step-Level Accuracy: Individual Task Performance
nodes.rationale: Evaluation metric measuring average success rate over individual task instances; each solved version or milestone contributes one correct step.

nodes.label: Regression Analysis: Pass-to-Pass Test Preservation
nodes.rationale: Analysis measuring whether agents break previously correct behavior; EvoMem reduces Pass-to-Pass failure rates from 9.09% to 6.32% on average.

nodes.label: Evidence Capture: Complete Preference State Preservation
nodes.rationale: Analysis measuring whether memory preserves complete preference evidence; row-level capture improves from 72.5% to 74.9% with EvoMem.

nodes.label: Temporal Trajectory Reasoning: Preference Evolution Tracking
nodes.rationale: Question type requiring tracking how preferences change over time; EvoMem improves accuracy by 5.2% on PersonaMem-Evo temporal trajectory questions.

nodes.label: Multi-Pattern Synthesis: Dispersed Evidence Integration
nodes.rationale: Question type requiring retaining multiple preference signals scattered across interaction history; EvoMem improves accuracy by 5.2%.

nodes.label: Operationalization Hypothesis: Patch Uptake Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis that EvoMem helps when retrieved transitions are operationalized; patch uptake shows 8.3% gain vs 2.6% when no uptake occurs.

nodes.label: Efficiency-Accuracy Trade-off Analysis
nodes.rationale: Analysis showing higher token usage does not reliably translate to higher accuracy; Gemma-4-31B achieves best accuracy with below-average token usage.

nodes.label: Persistent Environment Evolution: Core Evaluation Concept
nodes.rationale: Core concept where same environment or user state evolves across versions; agents must adapt to new changes while preserving still-valid prior behavior.

nodes.label: Implicit Change Handling: Context-Based Inference
nodes.rationale: Capability where agents must infer or handle changes from context or interaction rather than explicit notifications.

nodes.label: Forward Adaptation: New Change Responsiveness
nodes.rationale: Capability to adapt to new environment changes while maintaining compatibility with previously accumulated codebase changes.

nodes.label: Version Compatibility: Prior Knowledge Preservation
nodes.rationale: Capability to preserve behavior that remains valid under current version while avoiding reuse of behaviors tied to obsolete versions.

nodes.label: EvoMem: Evolutionary Memory Framework
nodes.rationale: EvoMem is a lightweight memory augmentation layer designed to support sequential task chains by maintaining patch-based memory of prior executions, enabling agents to adapt solutions across evolving tasks without replaying full trajectories.

nodes.label: Terminus2 with EvoMem
nodes.rationale: Chain-scoped patch memory layer for terminal-native task solving; maintains execution ledgers and transition patches to guide strategy adaptation across sequential terminal tasks.

nodes.label: OpenHands with EvoMem
nodes.rationale: Patch-memory layer for sequential software-engineering tasks; distills code-context memory from prior implementation changes to provide historical debugging context without replaying old patches verbatim.

nodes.label: Memento-Skill with EvoMem
nodes.rationale: Versioned tip-patching layer on top of Memento-Skill; maintains tip-version families with metadata tracking evidence and rationale, enabling selective reuse of task-solving experience across skill execution.

nodes.label: A-Mem with EvoMem
nodes.rationale: Patch-augmented extension of A-Mem; maintains both current memory graph and temporally indexed history of memory edits to capture non-additive revisions caused by later turns.

nodes.label: SWE-Chain-Evo: Software Evolution Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Dataset of 48 milestone chains from 26 repositories with 135 total milestones; evaluates cumulative codebase evolution where agents must satisfy new requirements while respecting constraints from earlier development steps.

nodes.label: PersonaMem-Evo: Persona Memory Evolution Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Benchmark for evaluating whether agents can infer, track, and generalize user's evolving latent preferences from long-horizon interaction histories; emphasizes implicit behavioral evidence over explicit fact lookup.

nodes.label: Terminal-Bench-Evo: Terminal Task Evolution
nodes.rationale: Evaluation setting where terminal tasks evolve across deployment mechanism, filesystem layout, permission model, and branch semantics while maintaining stable user-facing goal.

nodes.label: Milestone Construction Process
nodes.rationale: Groups nearby commits by semantic relatedness, verifies code changes contribute to same functionality/goal, filters noisy modifications, and manually validates for semantic coherence and evaluation reliability.

nodes.label: Temporal Preference Evolution
nodes.rationale: Samples structured evolution plans with five change families (same-object attitude revision, object replacement, conditional shift, attribute shift, temporal-validity shift); generates conversational episodes reflecting updated preference states.

nodes.label: OOD Preference-Inference Question Generation
nodes.rationale: Generates four OOD question types (single-pattern transfer, multi-pattern synthesis, conflict resolution, temporal trajectory prediction) at three complexity levels; requires abstraction over long interaction history.

nodes.label: Dual-Blind Filtering for OOD Questions
nodes.rationale: Validates OOD questions cannot be answered from persona profile alone or from commonsense; applies adversarial option rewriting when needed to ensure questions require conversational memory.

nodes.label: Chain Assembly for Sequential Tasks
nodes.rationale: Assembles milestones into temporally ordered chains within same repository; later tasks evaluated on codebases including accumulated changes from earlier milestones.

nodes.label: Execution Ledger
nodes.rationale: Compact record of reusable procedure information from prior terminal solution: task goal, strategy summary, artifact types, command patterns, ineffective notes, and output requirements.

nodes.label: Transition Patch
nodes.rationale: Summarizes non-additive change across neighboring tasks: what requirement changed, which assumption was superseded, what adaptation was observed, and which values should not be copied blindly.

nodes.label: Patch Memory Retrieval and Rendering
nodes.rationale: Retrieves relevant transition patches based on task-contract changes and lexical matching; renders selected context into compact memory document materialized in task container.

nodes.label: Preference Record Structure
nodes.rationale: Structured record specifying latent preference expressed by dialogue: preference text, source category, owner (self/others), temporal status, and generated conversation.

nodes.label: Five Change Families for Preference Evolution
nodes.rationale: Taxonomy of preference transitions: same-object attitude revision (30%), object replacement (30%), conditional preference shift (13%), attribute shift (13%), temporal-validity shift (14%).

nodes.label: Implicit Interaction History Construction
nodes.rationale: Generates multi-turn dialogues where preferences are expressed indirectly through choices, constraints, tone, and repeated requests without explicit declarative statements.
